# DEPLOY1R2 read-only final review

**Verdict: APPROVED** — sole prior **P2** (weak `must200` HTTP `_next` checks) is closed in code with a shared strict helper, exercised HTTP loop coverage, and focused regressions; no new **P0–P2** identified in DEPLOY1R2 scope. (No shell re-run; evidence from disk only.)

---

## Prior P2 verification (DEPLOY1R1 residual)

| Requirement | Evidence | Status |
|-------------|----------|--------|
| Every `must200` HTTP 200 body must include exact base-prefixed `/_next/` hydration | `assertBasePrefixedNextAssets` requires `` `${pagesBase}/_next/` `` (`smoke-pages.mjs` 99–104); loop 355–360 calls it for **each** of 15 paths (337–353: home, lessons, plain + encoded activity, concepts, vocabulary, search + query variants, practice, game, conversation + entity, detail rep) | **Closed** |
| Reject bare root `src`/`href` `/_next` | Same helper rejects `src="/_next/`, `href="/_next/`, and `"/_next/` (105–109) | **Closed** |
| Remove weak `PAGES_BASE \|\| "_next"` on `must200` | No `text.includes(PAGES_BASE)` / `includes("_next")` in `platform/`; source contract test forbids that pattern in the `must200` block (`deploy1r2-pages-smoke-hydration.test.ts` 61–73) | **Closed** |
| Align with game block strictness | Game probe reuses `assertBasePrefixedNextAssets(game.text, "game page")` (391); `must200` already includes `/practice/article-choice/` (349) | **Closed** |
| Real regression tests (not smoke-only) | Six vitest cases import and call exported `assertBasePrefixedNextAssets` from `smoke-pages.mjs` (accept, bare-only, base-without-`_next`, mixed bare `src`, bare `href`, source contract) | **Closed** |

```99:111:platform/apps/web/scripts/smoke-pages.mjs
/** Require base-prefixed hydration assets; reject bare root /_next. */
export function assertBasePrefixedNextAssets(html, label, pagesBase = PAGES_BASE) {
  assert(
    html.includes(`${pagesBase}/_next/`),
    `${label} missing base-prefixed _next hydration assets`,
  );
  assert(
    !html.includes('src="/_next/') &&
      !html.includes('href="/_next/') &&
      !html.includes("\"/_next/"),
    `${label} must not use bare root /_next`,
  );
}
```

```355:360:platform/apps/web/scripts/smoke-pages.mjs
    for (const path of must200) {
      const { status, text } = await fetchStatus(path);
      assert(status === 200, `${path} expected 200 got ${status}`);
      assert(text.length > 100, `${path} empty body`);
      assertBasePrefixedNextAssets(text, path);
    }
```

| Layer | Behavior vs DEPLOY1R1 |
|-------|------------------------|
| `verifyAssetRefsAndSecrets` sample HTML | Still requires `` `${PAGES_BASE}/_next/` `` or `` `"${PAGES_BASE}/"` `` (204–207) and still rejects bare `src`/`href` `/_next` (208–210) — unchanged pattern reviewer marked “not raised as P2” |
| Full `out/` leak walk | Same `FORBIDDEN_*` scans and path rules (214–241) |
| Post-`must200` checks | Index asset regex, 404 honesty, game markers, 404 leak guard (362–397) intact |
| `isDirectRun` guard | Helper importable for tests without running `main()` (417–431) |

DEPLOY1R2 **strengthens** HTTP `must200` only; it does not relax disk or leak gates.

---

## New P0–P2 (DEPLOY1R2 diff only)

| Severity | Finding |
|----------|---------|
| **P0** | None |
| **P1** | None |
| **P2** | None actionable |

**Out of scope for this APPROVE gate (unchanged from DEPLOY1R1):** P3 `ssg-dynamic-params.ts` tombstone; Action SHA spot-check without `gh api`; weaker disk-sample OR allowing `` `"${PAGES_BASE}/"` `` without `_next/` (defense-in-depth only, not regressed). Single-quoted bare `/_next` attrs are not in packet §6 wording and are not typical Next export output — not elevated to P2 here.

## Summary

- **P0:** none  
- **P1:** none  
- **P2:** prior sole residual **closed**; no new **P0–P2** in DEPLOY1R2 scope  

**APPROVED** for DEPLOY1R2 on the stated criterion (zero actionable **P0–P2** for base-prefixed `must200` hydration enforcement + regressions + non-weakened scans).
